modalities.evidence: BCI spelling outcomes and feedback event markers

output.population: Participants in single- and multi-session visual P300-based BCI speller studies, including individuals with an ALS diagnosis and ALS Functional Rating Scale score from medical records
output.summary: Curated collection of visual P300-based brain-computer interface speller studies, sharing EEG, stimulus and feedback event markers, eye tracker signals, and where available demographics and ALS diagnosis with functional rating scores.
